*Software Engineer — Remote — US Only* - US Work Authorization Required

Kaveronix is looking for experienced Software Engineers currently based in the United States for fully remote opportunity

*What we’re looking for:*

Candidates should have at least 4 years of professional experience in software engineering, with a strong understanding of modern development practices and workflows. Experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, TypeScript, or cloud platforms is preferred. Strong communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities are essential.

*What we offer:*

- Fully remote work - Flexible working hours - Competitive compensation based on experience

*Compensation:* $80,000–$180,000/year, depending on experience.

If you're interested, please send your resume to hassan.amir@kaveronix.com
